package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	StartSchema                      = "practice-task-instance-start.v2"
	StartedSchema                    = "practice-task-instance-started.v2"
	InstanceSchema                   = "practice-task-instance.v2"
	SubmitSchema                     = "practice-task-submit.v2"
	SubmissionSchema                 = "practice-task-submission.v2"
	RevisionDigestV1                 = "practice-task-revision-digest.v1"
	ValidationDigestV1               = "practice-validation-contract-digest.v1"
	LearningReadinessMasteryPolicyV1 = "student-mastery-v1"
)

type TaskInstanceStatus string

const (
	TaskInstanceStarting   TaskInstanceStatus = "STARTING"
	TaskInstanceInProgress TaskInstanceStatus = "IN_PROGRESS"
	TaskInstanceValidating TaskInstanceStatus = "VALIDATING"
	TaskInstanceInReview   TaskInstanceStatus = "IN_REVIEW"
	TaskInstanceFinalizing TaskInstanceStatus = "FINALIZING"
	TaskInstanceCompleted  TaskInstanceStatus = "COMPLETED"
	TaskInstanceCancelled  TaskInstanceStatus = "CANCELLED"
)

type SubmissionStatus string

const (
	SubmissionValidating       SubmissionStatus = "VALIDATING"
	SubmissionFailed           SubmissionStatus = "FAILED"
	SubmissionReviewRequired   SubmissionStatus = "REVIEW_REQUIRED"
	SubmissionChangesRequested SubmissionStatus = "CHANGES_REQUESTED"
	SubmissionPassed           SubmissionStatus = "PASSED"
)

type ValidationRunStatus string

const (
	ValidationRunPending ValidationRunStatus = "PENDING"
	ValidationRunRunning ValidationRunStatus = "RUNNING"
	ValidationRunPassed  ValidationRunStatus = "PASSED"
	ValidationRunFailed  ValidationRunStatus = "FAILED"
	ValidationRunError   ValidationRunStatus = "ERROR"
)

type ValidationOutcome string

const (
	OutcomePass  ValidationOutcome = "PASS"
	OutcomeFail  ValidationOutcome = "FAIL"
	OutcomeError ValidationOutcome = "ERROR"
)

var (
	ErrInvalid         = errors.New("invalid request")
	ErrNotFound        = errors.New("not found")
	ErrConflict        = errors.New("conflict")
	ErrIdempotency     = errors.New("idempotency conflict")
	ErrDependency      = errors.New("dependency unavailable")
	ErrAuthoringDefect = errors.New("invalid immutable revision")
	ErrVariantRequired = errors.New("solution variant selection is required")
	canonicalUUID      = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`)
	canonicalDigest    = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)
	localePattern      = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z]{2}(?:-[a-z0-9]{2,8})?$`)
)

type StartCommand struct {
	StudentID             string `json:"student_id"`
	IdempotencyKey        string `json:"idempotency_key"`
	TaskRevisionID        string `json:"task_revision_id"`
	Locale                string `json:"locale"`
	SurfaceClassification string `json:"-"`
	SolutionVariantID     string `json:"solution_variant_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathID        string `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathItemID    string `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID         string `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
}

func NormalizeStartCommand(input StartCommand) (StartCommand, error) {
	if input.StudentID != strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID) || input.IdempotencyKey != strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey) ||
		input.TaskRevisionID != strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionID) || input.Locale != strings.TrimSpace(input.Locale) ||
		input.LearningPathID != strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID) || input.SolutionVariantID != strings.TrimSpace(input.SolutionVariantID) || !IsCanonicalUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!IsCanonicalUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) || !IsCanonicalUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) ||
		(input.LearningPathID != "" && !IsCanonicalUUID(input.LearningPathID)) ||
		!ValidRequirementCorrelation(input.LearningPathItemID, input.RequirementID) || (input.LearningPathItemID != "" && input.LearningPathID == "") ||
		(input.SolutionVariantID != "" && !IsCanonicalUUID(input.SolutionVariantID)) ||
		(input.SurfaceClassification != "practice" && input.SurfaceClassification != "project") {
		return StartCommand{}, ErrInvalid
	}
	input.Locale = strings.ToLower(input.Locale)
	if !localePattern.MatchString(input.Locale) {
		return StartCommand{}, ErrInvalid
	}
	return input, nil
}

func IsCanonicalUUID(value string) bool {
	return canonicalUUID.MatchString(value)
}

func NormalizeSubmitCommand(input SubmitCommand) (SubmitCommand, error) {
	if input.TaskInstanceID != strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskInstanceID) || input.StudentID != strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID) ||
		input.IdempotencyKey != strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey) || input.MilestoneID != strings.TrimSpace(input.MilestoneID) ||
		!IsCanonicalUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) || !IsCanonicalUUID(input.StudentID) || !IsCanonicalUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) {
		return SubmitCommand{}, ErrInvalid
	}
	switch input.Scope {
	case "FINAL":
		if input.MilestoneID != "" {
			return SubmitCommand{}, ErrInvalid
		}
	case "MILESTONE":
		if !IsCanonicalUUID(input.MilestoneID) {
			return SubmitCommand{}, ErrInvalid
		}
	default:
		return SubmitCommand{}, ErrInvalid
	}
	return input, nil
}

func CommandDigest(command any) (string, error) {
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(command)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	canonical, err := CanonicalJSON(encoded)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(canonical)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

func StartCommandDigest(command StartCommand) (string, error) {
	return CommandDigest(struct {
		StudentID             string `json:"student_id"`
		IdempotencyKey        string `json:"idempotency_key"`
		TaskRevisionID        string `json:"task_revision_id"`
		Locale                string `json:"locale"`
		SurfaceClassification string `json:"surface_classification"`
		SolutionVariantID     string `json:"solution_variant_id,omitempty"`
		LearningPathID        string `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
		LearningPathItemID    string `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
		RequirementID         string `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	}{command.StudentID, command.IdempotencyKey, command.TaskRevisionID, command.Locale, command.SurfaceClassification, command.SolutionVariantID, command.LearningPathID, command.LearningPathItemID, command.RequirementID})
}

func CanTransitionInstance(from, to TaskInstanceStatus) bool {
	switch from {
	case TaskInstanceStarting:
		return to == TaskInstanceInProgress || to == TaskInstanceCancelled
	case TaskInstanceInProgress:
		return to == TaskInstanceValidating || to == TaskInstanceCancelled
	case TaskInstanceValidating:
		return to == TaskInstanceInProgress || to == TaskInstanceInReview || to == TaskInstanceFinalizing
	case TaskInstanceInReview:
		return to == TaskInstanceInProgress || to == TaskInstanceFinalizing
	case TaskInstanceFinalizing:
		return to == TaskInstanceCompleted
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// CanonicalJSON recursively sorts object keys, preserves array order and JSON
// scalar values, removes insignificant whitespace, and emits UTF-8 JSON.
func CanonicalJSON(raw json.RawMessage) ([]byte, error) {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	var value any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&value); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, ErrInvalid
	}
	return canonicalValue(value)
}

func canonicalValue(value any) ([]byte, error) {
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		keys := make([]string, 0, len(typed))
		for key := range typed {
			keys = append(keys, key)
		}
		sort.Strings(keys)
		var buffer bytes.Buffer
		buffer.WriteByte('{')
		for index, key := range keys {
			if index > 0 {
				buffer.WriteByte(',')
			}
			encodedKey, _ := json.Marshal(key)
			buffer.Write(encodedKey)
			buffer.WriteByte(':')
			encodedValue, err := canonicalValue(typed[key])
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			buffer.Write(encodedValue)
		}
		buffer.WriteByte('}')
		return buffer.Bytes(), nil
	case []any:
		var buffer bytes.Buffer
		buffer.WriteByte('[')
		for index, item := range typed {
			if index > 0 {
				buffer.WriteByte(',')
			}
			encoded, err := canonicalValue(item)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			buffer.Write(encoded)
		}
		buffer.WriteByte(']')
		return buffer.Bytes(), nil
	case json.Number:
		if !json.Valid([]byte(typed.String())) {
			return nil, ErrInvalid
		}
		return []byte(typed.String()), nil
	default:
		return json.Marshal(typed)
	}
}

// Digest hashes a version-tagged canonical payload. The payload is carried as
// JSON so callers cannot accidentally hash Go map iteration order.
func Digest(schema string, payload json.RawMessage) string {
	canonical, err := CanonicalJSON(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	var normalized any
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(canonical))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	if decoder.Decode(&normalized) != nil {
		return ""
	}
	preimage, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Schema  string `json:"schema"`
		Payload any    `json:"payload"`
	}{schema, normalized})
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	canonicalPreimage, err := CanonicalJSON(preimage)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(canonicalPreimage)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

type RevisionMetadata struct {
	ID             string    `json:"id"`
	PracticeTaskID string    `json:"practice_task_id"`
	RevisionNumber int       `json:"revision_number"`
	PublishedAt    time.Time `json:"published_at"`
}

type RevisionEnvelope struct {
	Schema               string           `json:"schema"`
	Revision             RevisionMetadata `json:"revision"`
	RevisionDigestSchema string           `json:"revision_digest_schema"`
	RevisionDigest       string           `json:"revision_digest"`
	RuntimeContext       json.RawMessage  `json:"runtime_context"`
	EvaluationContext    json.RawMessage  `json:"evaluation_context"`
}

func (envelope RevisionEnvelope) ComputedDigest() string {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Schema            string          `json:"schema"`
		RevisionID        string          `json:"revision_id"`
		RevisionNumber    int             `json:"revision_number"`
		RuntimeContext    json.RawMessage `json:"runtime_context"`
		EvaluationContext json.RawMessage `json:"evaluation_context"`
	}{RevisionDigestV1, envelope.Revision.ID, envelope.Revision.RevisionNumber, envelope.RuntimeContext, envelope.EvaluationContext})
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	canonical, err := CanonicalJSON(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(canonical)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

type Target struct {
	Type    string `json:"type"`
	Key     string `json:"key"`
	Version string `json:"version"`
}

type Step struct {
	ID                      string                    `json:"id"`
	Title                   string                    `json:"title"`
	Objective               string                    `json:"objective"`
	Deliverables            []string                  `json:"deliverables"`
	Acceptance              []Acceptance              `json:"acceptance"`
	MilestoneOrder          int                       `json:"milestone_order"`
	StepOrder               int                       `json:"step_order"`
	Required                bool                      `json:"required"`
	Status                  string                    `json:"status"`
	Targets                 []Target                  `json:"-"`
	ValidationContract      json.RawMessage           `json:"-"`
	EvaluationAssets        EvaluationAssets          `json:"-"`
	RuntimeProfile          json.RawMessage           `json:"-"`
	StarterFiles            []WorkspaceFile           `json:"-"`
	ReadinessReceipt        *LearningReadinessReceipt `json:"-"`
	ReadinessIdempotencyKey string                    `json:"-"`
}

type Acceptance struct {
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	Text         string `json:"text"`
	EvidenceKind string `json:"evidence_kind"`
}

type EvaluationAssets struct {
	TestSuiteRef          string   `json:"test_suite_ref,omitempty"`
	ReferenceSolutionRef  string   `json:"reference_solution_ref,omitempty"`
	NegativeFixtureRefs   []string `json:"negative_fixture_refs,omitempty"`
	VerificationRunnerRef string   `json:"verification_runner_ref,omitempty"`
}

type WorkspaceFile struct {
	Path    string `json:"path"`
	Content string `json:"content"`
}

type RevisionSummary struct {
	Schema         string    `json:"schema"`
	RevisionID     string    `json:"revision_id"`
	Digest         string    `json:"digest"`
	FamilyKey      string    `json:"family_key"`
	VariantKey     string    `json:"variant_key"`
	VariantID      string    `json:"-"`
	RevisionNumber int       `json:"revision_number"`
	Surface        string    `json:"surface"`
	Title          string    `json:"title"`
	Type           string    `json:"type"`
	PublishedAt    time.Time `json:"published_at"`
}

type WorkspaceBinding struct {
	Schema          string `json:"schema"`
	SandboxID       string `json:"sandbox_id"`
	Available       bool   `json:"available"`
	PreviewURL      string `json:"preview_url,omitempty"`
	GenerationID    string `json:"generation_id,omitempty"`
	WorkspaceDigest string `json:"workspace_digest,omitempty"`
}

type LearningRouteReceipt struct {
	Schema             string          `json:"schema"`
	ID                 string          `json:"id"`
	TaskInstanceID     string          `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string          `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest string          `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	StudentID          string          `json:"student_id"`
	Locale             string          `json:"locale"`
	PlannerVersion     string          `json:"planner_version"`
	RouteDigest        string          `json:"route_digest"`
	Steps              json.RawMessage `json:"steps"`
	CreatedAt          time.Time       `json:"created_at"`
}

type LearningReadinessReceipt struct {
	Schema               string    `json:"schema"`
	ID                   string    `json:"id"`
	TaskInstanceID       string    `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID            string    `json:"student_id"`
	TaskRevisionID       string    `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest   string    `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	RouteID              string    `json:"route_id"`
	RouteDigest          string    `json:"route_digest"`
	StepID               string    `json:"step_id"`
	Decision             string    `json:"decision"`
	LearnerStateDigest   string    `json:"learner_state_digest"`
	MasteryPolicyVersion string    `json:"mastery_policy_version"`
	ObservedAt           time.Time `json:"observed_at"`
}

func ValidLearningReadinessReceipt(receipt LearningReadinessReceipt) bool {
	return receipt.Schema == "practice-learning-readiness-receipt.v1" && IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.ID) &&
		IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.TaskInstanceID) && IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.StudentID) &&
		IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.TaskRevisionID) && IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.RouteID) &&
		canonicalDigest.MatchString(receipt.TaskRevisionDigest) && canonicalDigest.MatchString(receipt.RouteDigest) &&
		canonicalDigest.MatchString(receipt.LearnerStateDigest) &&
		(receipt.Decision == "READY" || receipt.Decision == "NOT_READY") &&
		receipt.MasteryPolicyVersion == LearningReadinessMasteryPolicyV1 && !receipt.ObservedAt.IsZero()
}

type LearningPathReference struct {
	ReferenceType string `json:"reference_type"`
	ReferenceID   string `json:"reference_id"`
}

type Progress struct {
	PassedSteps int     `json:"passed_steps"`
	TotalSteps  int     `json:"total_steps"`
	Percentage  float64 `json:"percentage"`
}

type TaskInstance struct {
	Schema                  string                 `json:"schema"`
	ID                      string                 `json:"id"`
	StudentID               string                 `json:"student_id"`
	TaskRevisionID          string                 `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest      string                 `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	Status                  TaskInstanceStatus     `json:"status"`
	SurfaceClassification   string                 `json:"surface_classification"`
	Locale                  string                 `json:"locale"`
	LearningActionID        string                 `json:"learning_action_id"`
	LearningPathID          string                 `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathItemID      string                 `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID           string                 `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathReference   *LearningPathReference `json:"learning_path_reference,omitempty"`
	SolutionVariantID       string                 `json:"-"`
	WorkspaceBinding        WorkspaceBinding       `json:"workspace_binding"`
	LearningRoute           LearningRouteReceipt   `json:"learning_route"`
	Steps                   []Step                 `json:"steps"`
	CurrentStep             *Step                  `json:"current_step,omitempty"`
	Progress                Progress               `json:"progress"`
	CurrentSubmissionID     string                 `json:"current_submission_id,omitempty"`
	FinalSubmissionID       string                 `json:"final_submission_id,omitempty"`
	StartedAt               time.Time              `json:"started_at"`
	CompletedAt             *time.Time             `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
	UpdatedAt               time.Time              `json:"updated_at"`
	RevisionSummary         RevisionSummary        `json:"-"`
	RevisionEnvelope        RevisionEnvelope       `json:"-"`
	StartCommandDigest      string                 `json:"-"`
	Provisioning            ProvisioningReceipts   `json:"-"`
	ReviewRequired          bool                   `json:"-"`
	AssistancePolicyVersion string                 `json:"-"`
	HintsUsed               int                    `json:"-"`
	MaxHintLevel            *int                   `json:"-"`
	TeacherAssistanceUsed   bool                   `json:"-"`
	Version                 int64                  `json:"-"`
}

type ProvisioningReceipts struct {
	StudentReserved  bool `json:"student_reserved"`
	RouteResolved    bool `json:"route_resolved"`
	WorkspaceCreated bool `json:"workspace_created"`
	StudentOpened    bool `json:"student_opened"`
}

func (instance TaskInstance) PublicProjection() TaskInstance {
	instance.RevisionSummary = RevisionSummary{}
	instance.RevisionEnvelope = RevisionEnvelope{}
	instance.StartCommandDigest = ""
	instance.Provisioning = ProvisioningReceipts{}
	instance.ReviewRequired = false
	instance.AssistancePolicyVersion = ""
	instance.HintsUsed = 0
	instance.MaxHintLevel = nil
	instance.TeacherAssistanceUsed = false
	return instance
}

type StartResult struct {
	Schema   string          `json:"schema"`
	Instance TaskInstance    `json:"instance"`
	Revision RevisionSummary `json:"revision"`
}

type SubmitCommand struct {
	TaskInstanceID string `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID      string `json:"student_id"`
	IdempotencyKey string `json:"idempotency_key"`
	Scope          string `json:"scope"`
	MilestoneID    string `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
}

type SnapshotRef struct {
	SandboxID       string `json:"sandbox_id"`
	SnapshotID      string `json:"snapshot_id"`
	GenerationID    string `json:"generation_id"`
	WorkspaceDigest string `json:"workspace_digest"`
}

type ValidationRun struct {
	SafeSummary         *ValidationSummary  `json:"safe_summary,omitempty"`
	ID                  string              `json:"id"`
	Status              ValidationRunStatus `json:"status"`
	Outcome             ValidationOutcome   `json:"outcome,omitempty"`
	ErrorClassification string              `json:"error_classification,omitempty"`
	StartedAt           *time.Time          `json:"started_at,omitempty"`
	FinishedAt          *time.Time          `json:"finished_at,omitempty"`
}

type HumanReviewReceipt struct {
	ReviewerID string    `json:"reviewer_id"`
	Decision   string    `json:"decision"`
	Feedback   string    `json:"feedback,omitempty"`
	ReviewedAt time.Time `json:"reviewed_at"`
}

type Submission struct {
	Schema                   string              `json:"schema"`
	ID                       string              `json:"id"`
	TaskInstanceID           string              `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID                string              `json:"student_id"`
	Scope                    string              `json:"scope"`
	MilestoneID              string              `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
	Snapshot                 SnapshotRef         `json:"snapshot"`
	WorkspaceDigest          string              `json:"workspace_digest"`
	Status                   SubmissionStatus    `json:"status"`
	ValidationRuns           []ValidationRun     `json:"validation_runs"`
	CurrentValidationSummary *ValidationSummary  `json:"current_validation_summary,omitempty"`
	HumanReview              *HumanReviewReceipt `json:"human_review,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt                time.Time           `json:"created_at"`
	CompletedAt              *time.Time          `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
	UpdatedAt                time.Time           `json:"updated_at"`
	ValidationSpecification  json.RawMessage     `json:"-"`
	ValidationContractDigest string              `json:"-"`
	RevisionDigest           string              `json:"-"`
	RequiresHumanReview      bool                `json:"-"`
	IdempotencyKey           string              `json:"-"`
	CommandDigest            string              `json:"-"`
}

func (submission Submission) PublicProjection() Submission {
	submission.CurrentValidationSummary = submission.CurrentSafeValidationSummary()
	submission.ValidationRuns = append([]ValidationRun(nil), submission.ValidationRuns...)
	for index := range submission.ValidationRuns {
		submission.ValidationRuns[index].SafeSummary = nil
	}
	submission.ValidationSpecification = nil
	submission.ValidationContractDigest = ""
	submission.RevisionDigest = ""
	submission.RequiresHumanReview = false
	submission.IdempotencyKey = ""
	submission.CommandDigest = ""
	return submission
}

type SubmitIntent struct {
	TaskInstanceID           string          `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID                string          `json:"student_id"`
	IdempotencyKey           string          `json:"idempotency_key"`
	CommandDigest            string          `json:"command_digest"`

	Scope                    string          `json:"scope"`
	MilestoneID              string          `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
	ValidationContractDigest string          `json:"validation_contract_digest"`
	ValidationSpecification  json.RawMessage `json:"validation_specification"`
	Status                   string          `json:"status"`
	CreatedAt                time.Time       `json:"created_at"`
	Snapshot                 SnapshotRef     `json:"snapshot,omitempty"`
	WriteLockID              string          `json:"write_lock_id,omitempty"`
	FenceEpoch               int64           `json:"fence_epoch,omitempty"`
	UpdatedAt                time.Time       `json:"updated_at,omitempty"`
}

type ValidationResult struct {
	TaskInstanceID           string            `json:"task_instance_id"`
	SubmissionID             string            `json:"submission_id"`
	ValidationRunID          string            `json:"validation_run_id"`
	RevisionDigest           string            `json:"revision_digest"`
	ValidationContractDigest string            `json:"validation_contract_digest"`
	Snapshot                 SnapshotRef       `json:"snapshot"`
	Outcome                  ValidationOutcome `json:"outcome"`
	ErrorClassification      string            `json:"error_classification,omitempty"`
	Stages                   []ValidationStage `json:"stages,omitempty"`
}

type ValidationStage struct {
	StageID  string            `json:"stage_id"`
	Required bool              `json:"required"`
	Outcome  string            `json:"outcome"`
	Issues   []ValidationIssue `json:"issues"`
}

type ValidationIssue struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

type APIError struct {
	Code string `json:"code"`
}

func (e APIError) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf("practice runtime: %s", e.Code) }

// ValidRequirementCorrelation checks opaque Student-owned assignment identity.
func ValidRequirementCorrelation(itemID, requirementID string) bool {
	return (itemID == "" && requirementID == "") || (IsCanonicalUUID(itemID) && IsCanonicalUUID(requirementID))
}
